subject: Reference-modification
notes: kb/Work PB1457 (landed w1033d). Rule (cite.py --check 8.4.3.3.3 OK, SR5): 'Unless otherwise specified, reference modification is allowed anywhere an identifier referencing a data item of class alphanumeric, boolean, or national is permitted' + NOTE 'where data-name-n is used in a general format or syntax rule, then reference-modification is not permitted'. PERMISSION HALF verified by the registrar (registrar 15c, --std 2023): INSPECT, STRING sending, UNSTRING, boolean and national MOVE, EVALUATE subject, INITIALIZE, intrinsic arguments, CALL BY REFERENCE/CONTENT, ACCEPT, MOVE into numeric-display slices; the 'unless otherwise specified' exclusions are refused (STRING INTO 14.9.43.3 SR4 COBOL1651, SEARCH identifier-1 14.9.37.3 SR1 COBOL2075, CORRESPONDING COBOL1757). NOTE HALF: every data-name-n position is refused. File clauses, OCCURS DEPENDING/KEY, SORT/MERGE KEY, REDEFINES: COBOL2024 (DataBinder.ScreenDataNameShape); READ KEY COBOL0864; START KEY COBOL0862; ALLOCATE/FREE/SET ADDRESS OF operands are pointers or BASED items, refused by 8.4.3.3.3 SR1 (COBOL1647) and 14.9.39.3 SR18 (COBOL0869); GENERATE data-name-1 does not parse with a reference modifier; SEND/RECEIVE (message-tag) are the documented-unsupported messaging facility. The PARTIAL's one defect, SEARCH ALL Format 2's WHEN data-name-1 and every AND data-name-2 (14.9.37.2), is closed: SearchAllFormat2Rules.CheckKeySide asks DataBinder.ScreenReferenceModifier (the reference-modifier arm of ScreenDataNameShape, one sentence in ReportReferenceModified) and reports COBOL2024; the subscript arm is NOT asked there because 14.9.37.3 SR8 requires the index-name subscript. A reference-modified identifier-3 on the sending side stays legal (pb1457_search_all_sending_refmod_legal prints FOUND=02). [editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the 'identifier' permission and the data-name NOTE are 85 lineage; the boolean and national classes join in 2002)] kb/Work PB2511 (w1045a): the SORT Format 2 subject data-name-2 is the sixth data-name-n procedure position screened (after the SORT/MERGE keys, the table SORT key, SEARCH ALL data-name-1, READ KEY and START KEY).
